title: Regen Config
description: Configuration for `devai inventory contracts --regen`: declares the set of generators (OpenAPI → TypeScript, JSON Schema → TypeScript, etc.) whose output is committed to the repo. `inv contracts --regen` runs each generator, re-snapshots the listed outputs, and reports any byte drift — catching 'agent hand-edited generated code' regressions.

command.description: Argv form of the command to run (no shell). First element is the executable; rest are arguments.

outputs.description: Repo-relative paths to files that the command produces. Each is snapshotted before + after the command runs; any drift is reported.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the command (default: repo root).
